result_preview.title: BOM Compliance Validator Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously validates bill of materials against regulatory and supplier qualification requirements.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically scans product bills of materials to verify compliance with regulatory standards, restricted substance directives, and active supplier qualifications. It flags non-compliant materials and components, recommends approved substitutes, and generates compliance documentation for product records. This reduces manual review cycles and ensures products meet market-specific requirements before engineering release.
useCases: Verify all product components meet current regulatory and engineering standards
Confirm product specifications align with approved material lists before production
Engineering team confirms new product revision has compliant materials and components.
Quality assurance validates material changes against regulatory requirements before release.

Automates compliance verification across product variants to ensure manufacturing readiness and regulatory adherence.
